$comment: Staff PWA on a 6" mid-range Android over 4G: LCP ≤ 2.5 s, CLS ≤ 0.1, initial JS ≤ 200 KB gz (D-179, docs/performance-budgets.md) — a hard limit. Measured as a phone with the Lighthouse mobile preset, signed in as the staff persona (scripts/lhci.ts); the staff host is reached through its Host header (`STAFF_HOST`). F4 adds Today, the reading round, inspections, devices and the install wizard (capture, camera and signature chunks load on first use). F4 4.4 (R2): Today from the staff tasks, work orders, a work order, parcels. The realtime stream is blocked (blockedUrlPatterns): an open event stream never lets the page go network-idle, so each run would wait out Lighthouse's 45 s load limit; maxWaitForLoad caps a page that still never goes quiet at 15 s (the metrics come from the trace either way).
